simple.meaning: מִגְדַּל־גָּד (Migdal-Gâd) is a Hebrew word meaning “Migdal-Gad , a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4028. Migdal -gad מִגְדַּלגַּֿד proper name ( tower of Gad ) stronghold in Judah Josh 15:37 ; — compare Magdala , Lag Onom. 139, 12, 2nd ed. 171 ; possibly Mejdel , eastward of Askalon, Guérin Judée ii. 130 f. compare Bd Pal 162 .
